status: Registered before physical fit/dev access or synthetic recovery check; no model candidates or endpoint selection.
entry: examples/glass_autoresearch/cycle_models.py preflight|fit|dev --work PRIVATE [--public PUBLIC] (fit/dev separately authorized); load(path); predict(model,shell,stratum) -> Nx3 float64 probabilities: stratum, packing, learned.
contract: Eligible observations only, equal weight. Packed 49-byte vacancy shell, little endian, boundary_models.SHELL oriented z,y,x (386 sites). No anchor/parent/center pattern, coordinates other than registered geometry, or labels used at inference. Use common design.json. All probabilities clipped to [1e-7,1-1e-7] before any score. No other radius.
nuisance: Jeffreys stratum logits log((n1+.5)/(n0+.5)), on all fit for deployment; within training fold only for OOF logits, prior 0 if a pilot-eligible stratum is absent in a fit fold. No dev/held-apart calibration.
packing: Half-sum of logit residuals on same nuisance logit: (1) Logistic on all signed sites (2*vacancy-1) + standardized boundary_models.features[:D], L2 .001 * squared norm / 2 on mean logistic objective with unpenalized residual intercept, L-BFGS. (2) Conventional features[:D] only HistGradientBoostingClassifier, lr=.05, max_iter=150,max_leaf_nodes=15,min_samples_leaf=20,l2_regularization=1,early_stopping=false,random_state=260405. Per-row case/control weights 1-p_s / p_s respectively remove nuisance odds conditionally. Conventional features are density/cubic radial, centered pairs, period-2 + optimized 20-site crystal templates and Fourier powers. Unweighted equal-logit blend frozen.
crossfit: Sort unique fit parent IDs, permute via PCG64(260405), alternate to form two disjoint folds. For each fit both base components and nuisance on other parents then predict. Final deployment fits same base on whole fit after OOF; never see dev in parameter fitting.
encoder: Signed oriented bits and centered/scaled pooled tangent-window D4 orbit frequencies (boundary_models.features[D:]); population SD floor 1e-6. Affine hidden tanh width 32, affine 4-state softmax at fixed temperature 1. Glorot uniform PCG64(260406) for both matrices; biases zero. Decoder starts [-.75,-.25,.25,.75]. No stratum or baseline input to encoder. Conditional, label-targeted RSMI-style predictive bound, not an estimator of all mutual information: maximize sum_k q(k|shell) log Bern(Y; sigmoid(fixed OOF packing logit + decoder_k)). Subtracting baseline log score is parameter-independent. No entropy reward, annealing, dropout, retries, restarts or tuning.
optimizer: Exact soft categorical expectation, Adam lr=.001,beta=(.9,.999),eps=1e-8. Fresh permutation per epoch from same PCG64(260406) stream after Glorot draws. Batch 512 incl final partial; 32 epochs. Record checkpoints 8,16,32, never select on dev. At each checkpoint take lowest-index argmax on tie and refit four offsets on fit labels at fixed OOF logits using unit ridge on summed Bernoulli loss (unoccupied state offset 0). Deploy epoch 32 only. Save hard fit OOF-offset diagnostics and dev scores for all registered checkpoints; hard entropy, conditional label counts and soft conditional objective tracked. No likelihood improvement by itself proves cavity evidence.
gates: On dev at least two hard states each with >=1% of eligible mass, plus shared support and precision gates. Report dev score trajectory and whether still rising. Failure of control/collapse/insufficient precision cannot imply a physical null.
synthetic_control: Not physical data and not a power guarantee. PCG64(260407); 64 synthetic fit and 32 held pseudo-parents, 128 rows per parent; shell background iid Bern(.25). Two independent fair latent signs, strips |z|=4, |y|<=2, x<0 vs x>=0. Strip vacancy rates .75/.05 swapped between +/-z face by corresponding sign. Independent fair binary stratum; Bernoulli label logit = +/- .6 by stratum + 2.5*product(signs). Same full one-start fitting pipeline; held synthetic hard learned-minus-packing >.01 nat, entropy>.20 nat and >=2 states each >=1%. Also check variational gradients in float64 by finite differences (max abs err <1e-6). No tuning if these fail.
files: Private: cycle-model.joblib,cycle-fit.json,cycle-dev.json,cycle-control.json. Exact final model bytes copied to public cycle-model.joblib with SHA256 in fit receipt. No hidden candidate choice. No cold/hot/transfer scoring by trainer.
